name: Colphne

skills.name: Quick Reaction
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Crisis Aid
skills.description: Selects 1 allied target within 6 tiles, restoring their HP equal to 100% of attack and applies Continuous Healing II and Continuous Stability Regen I to them for 1 turn. Gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Faint Glow of the Battlefield
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles, dealing Hydro damage equal to 130% of attack. Additionally, restores HP equal to 100% of attack to the allied unit with the lowest HP.

skills.name: Emergency Treatment
skills.description: Selects 1 allied target within 8 tiles, restoring HP equal to 140% of attack and 4 points of stability, cleansing 2 debuffs alongside removing Taunt and Fear effects.

skills.name: Medical Contingency
skills.description:
When an enemy unit within range receives targeted damage from an allied unit, prioritizes performing 1 instance of Action Support, dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of attack and 3 points of Stability Damage to them, and applies Attack Up I to the allied unit for 2 turns. Gains 1 point of Confectance Index. This can be triggered once per turn.

When applying an active heal to an allied unit, if the target is in Stability Break, additionally restores 2 points of Stability Index. Cooldown: 2 turns.

fortification.effect: If the target's HP is fully restored after healing, randomly grant it 1 buff for 2 turns.
Gains 1 extra Action Support this turn.
Stability Index recovery increases by 2 points.
Increases Stability Index Recovery by 1 point.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Doctor's Orders
keys.effect: The active skill Crisis Aid applies Defense Up I and Shelter to the target for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Quick Surgery
keys.effect: If an allied target enters into Stability Break after being attacked, gain Movement Up II for 1 turn for self.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Emergency Express
keys.effect: The effects of the active skill Faint Glow of the Battlefield is enhanced. It also recovers HP to allied targets within a 3 tiles.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Combat Medic
keys.effect: When the HP of the user is above 80%, increases their attack by 10%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Recovery at Rest
keys.effect: Randomly cleanses 1 debuff from the target after healing.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Fast Recovery
keys.effect: When using active heals on targets below 50% HP, increases healing effect by 20%.

keys.name: Common Key - Fabricated Life
keys.effect: HP +3.0% / Before using a single target active heal, cleanses 1 random debuff from the target.

keys.name: Expansion Key - Emotional Counselling Expert
keys.effect: When performing Action Support, the allied unit performing the Targeted attack recovers HP equal to 50% of ATK and 1 point of Stability.
